title: Weak $k$-metric dimension of Hamming graphs: rectangular products and near-maximum parameters
summary: We determine weak $k$-metric dimensions for several families of Hamming graphs. For $n\ge3$, $m>n$, and $3\le k\le2n$, a cyclic construction proves Conjecture 6.1 of Fernández, Klavžar, Kuziak, Muñoz-Márquez and Yero (2026) on $K_n\square K_m$. For these rectangular products, we also prove that $\operatorname{wdim}_2(K_n\square K_m)=m$ exactly when $m\ge2n-2$. For hypercubes $Q_d$ with $d\ge2$, we show that consecutive parameters $2s-1$ and $2s$ have identical weak resolving sets.
